plotSections.title: Mother's Prayer and the Chosen One
bullets: The DM recapped that Gerk appears to be a recurring chosen one who is selected generationally and brought forward to fulfill a foretold path.

The Mother's Prayer describes the chosen individual's journey toward a foretold end, but the path remains voluntary: if the chosen individual refuses it, the course changes and the role passes to another person deemed worthy.

plotSections.title: The Keystone Keepers
bullets: Each party member is now the owner and protector of a keystone, while two remaining keystones stay in the custody of Plymouth Gawater and Juten Prime.
The current assignments were reiterated: Walker holds The Reach, Ord holds Feldspar, Ciri holds Lith, Gerk holds Midgard, Sylan holds Gilbrick, and Dana holds Pitel.
The party remains responsible for protecting these powerful objects while continuing their effort to track down a lich and its phylactery.

plotSections.title: The Party's Night on Mount Advalia
bullets: The session began after the previous council and related conversations, with the party still at the gatehouse in Mount Advalia and only the previously mentioned NPCs remaining there.

The party's prior drinking and attempt to teach Ord to fly were revisited. Ord was taken into the air and dropped as a joke, failed the attempt, and ultimately fell into the water after being unable to control the descent; he was caught by the scruff of his neck before or during the fall.
Glimmen and Raiden were involved in the planned flying prank, with Glimmen intended to catch Ord if he failed to fly.

chronologicalEvents: The DM recapped the Mother's Prayer and Mother's Prophecy, explaining that Gerk appears to be a recurring generational chosen one whose foretold path remains a matter of choice.
The DM recapped that each party member now possesses and protects a keystone, with two remaining keystones entrusted to Plymouth Gawater and Juten Prime.
The DM restated the known keystone assignments: Gerk—Midgard; Sylan—Gilbrick; Dana—Pitel; Walker—The Reach; Ord—Feldspar; Ciri—Lith.
The party's remaining major objective is to track down a lich and its phylactery.
The gods from the previous council have departed, leaving Eldris, Araden, Juten Prime, Four Secundus, Kit Anger, and Plymouth Gawater at Mount Advalia.
The session opened with the party recalling that they had been drinking on the mountain and had attempted to teach Ord to fly.
Ord was taken into the air as part of the prank, failed his attempts to fly, and fell toward the water before being caught by the scruff of his neck.

notes: The DM reiterated that Gerk appears to be the current generational manifestation of a recurring chosen one connected to the Mother's Prayer.
Gerk's chosen path is not compulsory; refusing the foretold journey can cause the role to pass to another worthy individual.
Gerk is the party's keeper and protector of the Midgard keystone.
